messages:
emma-support: Hey team — customer (ACME LTD) trying to pay invoice INV-10234. Card declined at checkout. They say address is exactly as on file. Stripe webhook shows decline_code: incorrect_cvc and AVS results look mixed. Can payments take a look?

raj-payments: Got it. Please paste the gateway webhook payload & the PaymentIntent ID. Also which country was the billing address?

emma-support: Billing country: IE (Ireland). Customer used home address with accented characters. Payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "id": "evt_1LxXx2X...",
  "type": "payment_intent.payment_failed",
  "data": {
    "object": {
      "id": "pi_3LxYz9Abc...",
      "amount": 7500,
      "currency": "eur",
      "last_payment_error": {
        "code": "card_declined",
        "decline_code": "incorrect_cvc",
        "message": "The CVC number is incorrect.",
        "payment_method": {
          "card": {
            "brand": "visa",
            "last4": "4242",
            "exp_month": 10,
            "exp_year": 2026,
            "checks": {
              "cvc_check": "fail",
              "address_line1_check": "pass",
              "address_postal_code_check": "fail"
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

oliver-cs: Customer message: "I copied address from the portal, but the postal code got reformatted (space removed)." Could be postal code mismatch triggering AVS fail. Do we have AVS strictness set on the gateway for EU cards?

raj-payments: Quick checks: 1) BIN lookup shows card issuing country = IE, BIN brand = Visa. 2) cvc_check = fail and postal_code_check = fail — gateway is returning issuer declines for CVC and postal. Likely bank blocking.

sofia-ops: Can you paste the PaymentIntent ID and any internal payment logs? Need to confirm we didn't send an address with different normalization. Also check whether we retried with a different payment method token.

emma-support: PaymentIntent: pi_3LxYz9Abc... (same as payload). Internal log snippet:
```
2025-03-10T15:10:11Z INFO payments:attempt payment_intent=pi_3LxYz9Abc amount=75.00EUR method=pm_1Kxyz status=failed decline_code=incorrect_cvc avs_postal=FAIL
```

raj-payments: Repro steps for sandbox to simulate the same failure: use Stripe test token `tok_chargeDeclinedIncorrectCvc` and set billing_address.postal_code to an incorrect value. Example: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents \
  -u sk_test_xxx: \
  -d amount=7500 -d currency=eur \
  -d "payment_method_data[type]"=card \
  -d "payment_method_data[card][number]"=4242424242424242 \
  -d "payment_method_data[card][exp_month]"=10 \
  -d "payment_method_data[card][exp_year]"=2026 \
  -d "payment_method_data[card][cvc]"=123 \
  -d "payment_method_data[billing_details][address][postal_code]"=D02ABC \
  -d "payment_method_data[card][token]"=tok_chargeDeclinedIncorrectCvc
```

oliver-cs: Thanks. Customer says they typed postal code with a space (D02 ABC) and our frontend strips spaces -> D02ABC. That might be what the issuer expects the space, causing postal_code_check fail. Could we normalize to canonical form that issuer expects? Risky.

raj-payments: Short-term: ask customer to try updating card and re-enter full postal code including space. Also we can offer a manual payment link (hosted invoice update) so they can retry. Long-term: enable postal code formatting that preserves spaces for IE in the checkout normalization layer, and add a retry flow that prompts for re-entering CVC.

emma-support: I created a one-time hosted payment link and emailed it. Customer will try and report back. I also flagged invoice INV-10234 as "awaiting_payment_retry" in our CRM.

finance-ops: If customer retries and payment goes through, waive any late fees for them. I'll handle refunds/adjustments if we need to re-invoice.

raj-payments: Also adding a follow-up action: (1) Update gateway settings to require postal_code in verification payload for EU transactions. (2) Add an analytic to track address normalization mismatches next week. I'll file a quick RFC for checkout normalization. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Invoice INV-10234 status changed -> payment_pending (was draft) :paperclip:

emma-support: Thanks all — will update thread once customer confirms. :pray:
